Марузенски and I are going home after a
day out
when we somehow get lost.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Umm, did I majorly mess up? I'm not sure
how to
get back to a road I know!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I can't believe we ended up in this
trouble just
because I tried to take a
detour!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: Let's check the map on our phones!

text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer! There's a better way to
get out of a
situation like this!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer! There's a better way to
get out of a
situation like this!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
See, look over there. Let's ask the police
officer.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Sorry to bother you, but...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
After asking for directions at the police
box, we
make it back to familiar ground.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well, that settles that! I'm so glad I
asked the
officer!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I hear you can easily look up a map
using your
phone, but it's better to ask
someone, don't you
think?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
It also lets me stay true to what my
father taught
me!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
He said there's no shame in asking for
help when
you need it.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
No matter how great you are, you can't
do
everything by yourself.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
If you try to handle all your problems
alone, you
might get stuck...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
So to avoid that, make it a point to
connect with
others. That's what he told
me.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: That's a good attitude to have.

text_block_list.text:
Isn't it? It makes me happy to hear you
say so.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
It's not just about relying on someone or
having
them rely on you, it's about
supporting each
other...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I hope we can have that kind of
relationship too.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

I already think you're a very dependable

Trainer.

text_block_list.text:
You always help me so much in my
training and
the big races.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

Above all, it's thanks to you that I'm
able to run
so happily. ♪

I have to admit—you're like a reliable
big brother

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
You can wear my seal of approval with
pride! ♪

Oh, I'm so glad! ♪ It's very encouraging
to hear

I always want to be there for you,
Trainer!

But everything will be fine as long as

to support each other!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
So let's work together—not just as
Umamusume
and trainer, but as a
team! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Right! As partners! ♪ Now and forever!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I feel both pride and joy welling up in
my heart at
Марузенски's words.
